window: New team: free picks now for the R12+R13 double week · unlimited trades again before R14 (21–24 Nov)
bottom_line: Pick a squad built for just two rounds: unlimited trades open again before R14, so there's no reason to pay for the long term now. With the game's real prices, Valančiūnas (17.7) doesn't fit a winning squad, so Variation A goes Robinson, Feliz, Vezenkov (C), Malcolm and Diarra, with Payne as 6th man and coach Bartzokas (OLY), for 103.0 of 103.3 and about a 7% chance of 200+ in R12.

variations.name: Best shot at 200
variations.tagline: Captain Vezenkov plus the Olympiacos coach (one big night pays twice), two high-usage guards, and cheap minutes on the bench.
variations.captain_note: Vezenkov: 25 PIR over his last 3, and Milutinov (broken finger) misses Tuesday's game at Maccabi, so Olympiacos run even more through him.
variations.captain_plan: Captain Vezenkov on Tuesday. If he scores under about 15 PIR, move the armband to Feliz (Wednesday at Beşiktaş), your only starter who plays later.
reasoning: Two-round squad: unlimited trades come back before R14, so every credit goes on R12–R13 points, not long-term value.
Coach Bartzokas (OLY) rides the same game as captain Vezenkov: Olympiacos are 78% at Maccabi, so one big night pays twice.
Robinson runs Barcelona while Punter is out (20 PIR over his last 3), at home to Paris in the fastest game of the round.
Malcolm (21 PIR over his last 3, 30 minutes) and Payne (17.7, 25 minutes) are Efes' two most-used players at Dubai, and Bruno Fernando's absence opens the paint.
Diarra (10.8, 35% owned) is the affordable center now that Valančiūnas costs 17.7.
The bench is cheap minutes: Procida (10 → 23 minutes with Madrid's injuries), Frisch (26 minutes with Sedekerskis out), Diop (Booker out 3 months), Llull (4.2).
cancel_if: Diarra listed doubtful on Monday: Diop moves into the starting five and Llull becomes 6th man.
Malcolm or Payne ruled out: swap him for Herrera (5.9) and keep the change.

variations.name: Bryant + Fenerbahçe coach
variations.tagline: The best R12 squad on paper (Bryant at Baskonia, Fenerbahçe 83% vs ASVEL), but weaker in R13.
variations.captain_note: Vezenkov. Bryant (22.5 over his last 10) at Baskonia is the vice.
reasoning: Highest R12 chance of 200 (about 7%), but only about 2% in R13, where A is clearly better.
Bryant (17.6) is the most reliable guard in the league; he costs as much as Malcolm and Payne together.
Coach Jasikevicius (FBB): Fenerbahçe are 83% at home to ASVEL with a projected +11.
Pick this to go all-in on R12 and reshape for R13 with your 4 trades.
cancel_if: Bryant listed with any knock on Monday: use A.

variations.name: Moonshot: Robinson captain
variations.tagline: Captain Robinson (7% owned) in the fastest game of the round, with Bryant and coach Albert (VBC).
variations.captain_note: Robinson as captain: if Barcelona–Paris goes up-tempo and he gets 30, almost nobody has him. He fouled out twice last week, so it can go badly.
reasoning: Differential captain: Robinson is 7% owned, Vezenkov 47%. To climb the table you need the 30+ night others don't have.
Coach Albert (VBC): Valencia go to Belgrade in R12, then host Virtus in R13, the better coach game of the double week.
Lower expected score than A: take it only if you're chasing rank.
cancel_if: Robinson in foul trouble again in Barcelona's Sunday league game: captain Vezenkov instead.

alerts.text: Re-run 15 Nov evening: no change to the squad. I re-ran the optimiser with the official prices and the same 10 + Bartzokas (OLY) still come out best (4.6% averaged over R12–R13). Today's domestic games: Vezenkov (19 pts, 7 reb at Aris) and Robinson (rested in a 25-point Barça win) are fine. Feliz, Malcolm, Diarra and Diop were still playing at report time.
New team, no trade limit yet: pick the full squad before Tuesday's first tip-off (17 Nov). From R13 on it's 4 trades per round, and unlimited again before R14.
Prices are the official game's (imported from your browser on 15 Nov), so the costs here should match the app. Variation A costs 103.0 of 103.3.
Only Real Madrid play on Wednesday (at Beşiktaş). Feliz (starter) and Procida (bench) are your only late options for a captain switch.

Injuries that shaped these picks: Punter (Barcelona) out 3–6 weeks, Milutinov (Olympiacos) misses Tuesday, Booker (Milano) out about 3 months, Bruno Fernando (Efes) out 3–4 weeks, Mirotic (Valencia) out about 2 weeks.
This first report reuses today's research for the main team. From tomorrow the daily routine researches this team on its own.

rumours.text: Milano are signing center Ze'Rik Onyema from Scafati; the announcement is expected early next week.
rumours.impact: Diop's minutes shrink once Onyema is registered: fine for R12–R13, sell him in the R14 window.

rumours.text: Milutinov fractured the tip of his right index finger and misses Aris and Maccabi; return expected around 24 Nov.
rumours.impact: More shots and rebounds for Vezenkov in R12. Supports him as captain.

rumours.text: Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks with a calf injury (MRI); Papagiannis is back to cover.
rumours.impact: Weaker Efes frontcourt: good for Bacon and Dubai's bigs in R12.

players.name: Sasha Vezenkov
players.read: Captain. 25 PIR over his last 3 and Milutinov is out on Tuesday. 19.2, the biggest single cost, but a 200 round almost always needs a 30+ captain. [dom: GBL 15 Nov at Aris, 19 pts 7 reb in a 100-78 loss, no knock, eurohoops.net]

players.name: Justin Robinson
players.read: Runs Barcelona while Punter is out; 20 over his last 3. Fouled out twice last week. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Obradoiro 15' PIR 9 (108-83 rout, minutes managed), acb.com]

players.name: Andres Feliz
players.read: Madrid's injuries keep him at 25+ minutes; the only Wednesday starter, which keeps the captain switch open. [dom: ACB 8 Nov 21' PIR 15, acb.com]

players.name: Collin Malcolm
players.read: 21 PIR over his last 3 in 30 minutes; at Dubai, then home to ASVEL. [dom: BSL 8 Nov vs Tofaş, 7 pts in an 87-93 loss, beinsports.com.tr]

players.name: Cameron Payne
players.read: Up to 25 minutes, 17.7 over his last 3. The 6th man. [dom: unverified, BSL not auto-covered]

players.name: Aliou Diarra
players.read: Efficient (1 PIR per minute) but capped at about 20 minutes; Virtus are underdogs vs Panathinaikos. The affordable center. [dom: LBA 9 Nov vs Verona, 8 pts in a 95-81 win, oasport.it]

players.name: Gabriele Procida
players.read: Minutes 10 → 23 with Madrid's injuries; 5.3. Plays Wednesday. [dom: ACB 8 Nov 22' PIR 4, acb.com]

players.name: Clement Frisch
players.read: 26 minutes with Sedekerskis out; 5.5. [dom: ACB 7 Nov 27' PIR 13, acb.com]

players.name: Ousmane Diop
players.read: More minutes while Booker is out; 4.8. Sell in the R14 window once Onyema arrives. [dom: unverified]

players.name: Sergio Llull
players.read: The cheapest guard who plays (4.2), about 18 minutes; a pure enabler. [dom: ACB 8 Nov 22' PIR 6, acb.com]

watchlist.name: Jonas Valanciunas (ZAL, 17.7)
watchlist.why: The best center ceiling, but 17.7 doesn't fit a squad this round; a target for the R14 rebuild.

watchlist.name: Elijah Bryant (HTA, 17.6)
watchlist.why: In Variation B; the premium guard for R14.

watchlist.name: Rj Cole (MIL, 9.0)
watchlist.why: 24 minutes and under 1% owned: a differential 6th man.
